options.name: Slayer Talents
options.description: As a slayer gains experience, he learns a number of talents that aid him and confound his foes. Starting at 2nd level and every 2 levels thereafter, a slayer gains one slayer talent. Unless otherwise noted, a slayer cannot select an individual talent more than once. Talents marked with an asterisk (*) add effects to a slayer’s sneak attack . Only one of these talents can be applied to an individual attack, and the decision of which to use must be made before the attack roll is made. A complete listing of slayer talents can be found here: Slayer Talents
